clues.wordAConnection: Three strikes in a row is called a turkey
clues.wordBConnection: The centerpiece of the Thanksgiving table
clues.revealExplanation: Roll three strikes and you've earned a turkey, no oven required.

clues.wordBConnection: Shrek explains that ogres are like onions
clues.revealExplanation: Ogres are like onions: they both have layers.

clues.wordAConnection: Every computer runs on a chip
clues.wordBConnection: Chips and salsa
clues.revealExplanation: One chip goes in the computer, the other goes in the salsa.

clues.wordBConnection: An oven mitt
clues.revealExplanation: One mitt catches fly balls, the other catches hot trays.

clues.wordBConnection: A Dutch oven, the heavy cooking pot
clues.revealExplanation: Double Dutch on the playground, Dutch oven in the kitchen.

clues.wordBConnection: Jam is a spread for toast
clues.revealExplanation: You spread jam on toast and a spread on your bed.

clues.wordBConnection: To loaf around is to be lazy
clues.revealExplanation: Bread comes in a loaf, and lazy people loaf around.

clues.wordBConnection: A sour lemon makes your lips pucker
clues.revealExplanation: Lemons and kisses both get your lips to pucker.

clues.wordAConnection: Lemon zest is the grated peel
clues.wordBConnection: A zest for life
clues.revealExplanation: Grate a lemon for zest, or live life with zest.

clues.wordAConnection: Julius Caesar, ancient Rome's most famous leader
clues.wordBConnection: Caesar salad
clues.revealExplanation: Same name, different Caesar: the salad is named after restaurateur Caesar Cardini, not Rome's Julius.

clues.wordAConnection: You eat cereal from a bowl
clues.wordBConnection: The Super Bowl and college bowl games
clues.revealExplanation: Breakfast comes in a bowl, and so does football's biggest game.

clues.wordAConnection: A peach has a big pit in the middle
clues.wordBConnection: Princess Peach from Super Mario
clues.revealExplanation: Mario rescues Princess Peach; you just have to eat around the pit.

clues.wordBConnection: Boba tea, also called bubble tea
clues.revealExplanation: Those chewy pearls at the bottom of bubble tea are boba.

clues.wordBConnection: The game show Wheel of Fortune
clues.revealExplanation: One fortune comes after dinner, the other comes from spinning the wheel.

clues.wordBConnection: Volcanoes erupt lava
clues.revealExplanation: A lava cake erupts with chocolate instead of rock.

clues.wordAConnection: Molten chocolate cake has a gooey center
clues.wordBConnection: Volcanoes hold molten rock
clues.revealExplanation: Both have a molten middle, but only one is dessert.

clues.wordAConnection: Sesame seeds, like the ones on a burger bun
clues.wordBConnection: Sesame Street
clues.revealExplanation: Sesame Street on TV, sesame seeds on your bun.

clues.wordBConnection: You crack a nut to eat it
clues.revealExplanation: Whether it's a walnut or a secret message, you have to crack it first.

clues.wordAConnection: A swallow is a small bird
clues.wordBConnection: You swallow with your throat
clues.revealExplanation: A swallow can fly past you, or go down your throat.

clues.wordAConnection: Every tennis point starts with a serve
clues.wordBConnection: A waiter serves your food
clues.revealExplanation: A tennis player serves aces; a waiter serves appetizers.

clues.wordBConnection: You pitch a tent
clues.revealExplanation: Pitch a tent, then grab a pitchfork: farm camping.

clues.wordAConnection: A football coach runs the team
clues.wordBConnection: A stagecoach carried passengers in the Old West
clues.revealExplanation: One coach yells from the sidelines, the other is pulled by horses.

clues.wordBConnection: New Year's Eve
clues.revealExplanation: December has two famous Eves, one week apart.

clues.wordBConnection: Cupid is the mascot of Valentine's Day
clues.revealExplanation: Cupid's arrows are the reason for all those valentines.

clues.wordBConnection: Cram the night before a test
clues.revealExplanation: You cram clothes into a suitcase and facts into your head before a test.

clues.wordBConnection: Carrier pigeons once delivered messages
clues.revealExplanation: Before mail carriers had trucks, some messages went by carrier pigeon.

clues.wordBConnection: A grand piano
clues.revealExplanation: Grandma might be the one playing the grand piano.

clues.wordBConnection: Mother Goose nursery rhymes
clues.revealExplanation: One goose honks over your lake, the other tells nursery rhymes.

clues.wordAConnection: A bucket list of things to do in life
clues.wordBConnection: Santa makes a list and checks it twice
clues.revealExplanation: Santa checks his list twice; your bucket list just needs checking off.

clues.wordBConnection: Scratchy wool sweaters feel itchy
clues.revealExplanation: A bug bite and Grandma's wool sweater: two classic reasons to scratch.

clues.wordAConnection: The Wizard of Oz is caught hiding behind a curtain
clues.wordBConnection: A tornado carries Dorothy to Oz
clues.revealExplanation: A tornado gets Dorothy to Oz, and a curtain hides the Wizard's secret.

clues.wordBConnection: Charlotte's Web
clues.revealExplanation: In Charlotte's Web, a spider writes words in her web to save a pig.

clues.wordAConnection: Leonardo leads the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
clues.wordBConnection: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa
clues.revealExplanation: One Leonardo painted the Mona Lisa; the other fights crime in a blue mask.

clues.wordAConnection: Raphael is the red-masked Ninja Turtle
clues.wordBConnection: Raphael was a great Renaissance painter
clues.revealExplanation: The Ninja Turtles were named after Renaissance artists, Raphael included.

clues.wordBConnection: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006
clues.revealExplanation: Pluto is both Mickey's dog and the most famous dwarf planet.

clues.wordAConnection: A cabbage patch, as in Cabbage Patch Kids
clues.wordBConnection: A pirate's eye patch
clues.revealExplanation: Cabbages grow in a patch; pirates wear one.

clues.wordAConnection: Humpty Dumpty is usually pictured as an egg
clues.wordBConnection: Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall
clues.revealExplanation: An egg on a wall: that never ends well for Humpty Dumpty.
